issues.problem: Rule gave the just-because form as 'だから + とて'; the form is clause + からとて (だ belongs to a noun predicate, not to the particle).
issues.action: Rule now says 'clause + からとて: just because'.

issues.problem: Tip listed only 微動, 一顧 and 予想 as noun + だに set words, but the explanation and patterns also teach 想像だにしなかった.
issues.action: Added 想像 to the tip's list.

issues.problem: English for 出張がてら京都の紅葉を見てきました said the business trip was in Kyoto, which the Japanese does not state.
issues.action: Changed to 'On a business trip, I took the chance to see the autumn leaves in Kyoto.'

issues.problem: The list of set words left out 子供ながらに, one of the most common ながらに phrases.
issues.action: Added 子供ながらに (young as one was: 子供ながらに感動した) to the explanation.

issues.problem: Mistake note said 'ながらに never concedes anything', which is false for 子供ながらに (child though one was).
issues.action: Note now says that although after an adjective is ながらも and that ながらに is limited to its set words, so it is not a general 'although'.

issues.problem: The explanation and examples teach にして (Q6), but the rule and tip covered only five particles and left it out.
issues.action: Added にして (the age or stage at which something finally happens) to the rule and the tip.
